approvalTitle: 初洽單編輯頁面 - Tasks 審核
content:
# Tasks Document - 初洽單編輯頁面

## Phase 1: 基礎設施建置

- [ ] 1. 安裝 Syncfusion Vue 相依套件
  - Files: package.json, app.vue
  - 安裝所有必要的 @syncfusion/ej2-vue-* 套件
  - 在 app.vue 中註冊 Syncfusion 授權
  - Purpose: 建立 Syncfusion 元件庫基礎
  - _Leverage: 現有的 package.json, nuxt.config.ts_
  - _Requirements: 所有 UI 需求 (REQ-1 to REQ-6)_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec inquiry-form-edit, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Install all required Syncfusion Vue packages (@syncfusion/ej2-vue-buttons, @syncfusion/ej2-vue-navigations, @syncfusion/ej2-vue-inputs, @syncfusion/ej2-vue-dropdowns, @syncfusion/ej2-vue-calendars) and register license key in app.vue | Restrictions: Do not install Tailwind plugins, ensure license key is from environment variable, follow Syncfusion installation docs via Context7 MCP | _Leverage: Existing package.json structure, read Syncfusion installation guide via context7 | _Requirements: All UI requirements need Syncfusion components | Success: Syncfusion packages installed, license registered without console warnings. When the task is complete, mark it as in-progress in tasks.md using the Edit tool, implement the task, then use log-implementation to record implementation details with complete artifacts, and finally mark it as completed [x] in tasks.md._

- [ ] 2. 建立 TypeScript 型別定義
  - File: app/features/inquiry/types/inquiry.types.ts
  - 定義 InquiryFormData, BasicInfo, CustomerInfo, BanquetInfo, AdditionalInfo 等介面
  - 定義 DropdownOption, ValidationError, InquiryStatus 等輔助型別
  - Purpose: 建立完整的型別安全基礎
  - _Leverage: design.md 中的 Data Models 定義_
  - _Requirements: 所有資料結構需求_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec inquiry-form-edit, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: TypeScript Developer | Task: Create comprehensive TypeScript interfaces for inquiry form data structures based on design.md Data Models section, including InquiryFormData, BasicInfo, CustomerInfo, BanquetInfo, AdditionalInfo, DropdownOption, ValidationError, and InquiryStatus enum | Restrictions: Follow exact structure from design.md, use TypeScript 5.9+ features, all fields must match Figma design requirements | _Leverage: design.md Data Models section | _Requirements: REQ-1 to REQ-6 data structures | Success: All interfaces defined with proper types, no TypeScript errors, complete type coverage for all form fields. When the task is complete, mark it as in-progress [-] in tasks.md, implement the task, then use log-implementation to record implementation details with complete artifacts (include all interface definitions and their locations), and finally mark it as completed [x] in tasks.md._

- [ ] 3. 建立 Pinia Store
  - File: app/features/inquiry/store/inquiry.store.ts
  - 實作 useInquiryStore，管理表單狀態 (formData, isModified, isLoading)
  - 新增 actions: loadInquiry, updateField, resetForm
  - Purpose: 集中管理表單狀態
  - _Leverage: Pinia auto-imports, inquiry.types.ts_
  - _Requirements: 表單狀態管理需求_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec inquiry-form-edit, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Vue Developer with Pinia expertise | Task: Create Pinia store using Composition API setup syntax for inquiry form state management, implementing state (formData: InquiryFormData, isModified: boolean, isLoading: boolean) and actions (loadInquiry, updateField, resetForm) | Restrictions: Use Composition API, follow Nuxt 4 auto-import patterns, do not use Options API | _Leverage: Pinia documentation via context7, inquiry.types.ts | _Requirements: Form state management for all sections | Success: Store properly manages form state, actions update state correctly, isModified tracks changes accurately. - [ ] 4. 建立 API 層

  - 實作 inquiryApi 物件: getInquiry(id), createInquiry(data), updateInquiry(id, data)

When the task is complete, mark it as in-progress in tasks.md, implement the task, then use log-implementation to record implementation details with complete artifacts (include all API methods with their signatures, error handling patterns, and endpoint URLs), and finally mark it as completed in tasks.md._
